tested.pop_html: I rode this cruise myself. Most of the photos in the review are my own, and so is the video.What I checked: deck views, commentary, drinks and value for money. Full review ↓

pills.label: 3 docks · 15:30–23:00
pills.pop_html: Carl Lutz rakpart Dock 0: 15:45, 18:45, 22:15. Akadémia 3: 15:30, 17:15, 22:30. Vigadó 8/A: 23:00. About 75 minutes.📍 3 docks to choose from: Akadémia 3 is by the Chain Bridge, best from Parliament or the Basilica. Vigadó 8/A is by Vörösmarty tér, best from Váci utca. Carl Lutz rakpart Dock 0 is further north on the Pest bank. Pick the dock when you choose your time slot.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Guide language: English only.As listed for this ticket.

pills.label: Folding strollers only
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ⓘ varies by boat and dock; mobility scooters not allowed👶 Stroller: ✓ folding strollers only, non-folding ones are not allowed🎟️ Kids: free under 4, full price for 4-17; small dogs welcome on a lead with a muzzle

pills.label: Unlimited Prosecco & Beer
pills.pop_html: Unlimited for 75 minutes: Hungarian sparkling wine, Aperol, Hugo, Rossini and Limoncello spritzers, beer, lemonade and lemon-mint water. You start with a welcome glass of sparkling wine; refills at the bar. Food costs extra.The sparkling wine is dry, plus rosé or semi-sweet when available. Spirits and cocktails cost extra.

pills.label: Cocktail-party feel
pills.pop_html: Lively, not a quiet sightseeing hour. On my cruise the commentary was hard to hear over the party noise. Open top deck plus two indoor decks; board early for the best top-deck spots. Lemonade is self-service, so non-drinkers are covered too.

pills.label: Open top deck
pills.pop_html: Open top deck plus two warm indoor decks. Board early for the best top-deck spots.

pills.label: Lemonade too
pills.pop_html: Lemonade and lemon-mint water are part of the unlimited drinks. Self-service, so non-drinkers are covered.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: 75-minute Danube sightseeing cruise; Welcome glass of Hungarian sparkling wine; Unlimited Hungarian sparkling wine; Unlimited Aperol, Hugo, Rossini and Limoncello spritzers.Not included: Hotel pick-up and drop-off; Premium spirits and cocktails; Food (for sale at the bar).

best_for.pick_html: for the most refills per euro: 75 minutes of prosecco, spritzers and beer from three central docks.
best_for.skip_html: if you want food included or commentary in another language: it is English only.

pills.pop_html: Departures at 18:00, 19:30 and 21:00. About 75 minutes.📍 Petőfi tér 9: Pest bank between Elizabeth Bridge and Vigadó tér, an easy walk from Váci utca. Arrive 15 minutes early: boarding closes 5 minutes before departure.

pills.pop_html: English audio commentary via QR code on your own phone; bring headphones.From the listing.

pills.label: Not for wheelchairs

pills.label: Unlimited drinks

pills.label: Lively rooftop
pills.pop_html: Guests keep mentioning the music and the friendly crew. Everyone has a seat on the heated lower deck; rooftop seats are first come, first served. Soft drinks and homemade lemonade are included.

pills.label: Rooftop terrace
pills.pop_html: The largest open rooftop terrace on the Danube, according to the operator, plus an indoor panoramic deck that is heated in winter and air-conditioned in summer.Seating upstairs is limited and first come, first served.

pills.label: €17.50 on sale
pills.pop_html: €17.50 per adult on the date checked, 30% off the €25 list price. A VIP option with a private front area and bar was €35.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: 75-minute Danube sightseeing cruise; Largest open rooftop terrace in Budapest; Unlimited Prosecco, Aperol Spritz, Hugo Spritz, wine & craft beer; Unlimited soft drinks, homemade lemonade & water.Not included: Food and snacks; Hotel pick-up and drop-off; Headphones for the audio guide (bring your own).

best_for.pick_html: for the lowest price on this list and a huge open rooftop for photos.
best_for.skip_html: if you need a seat upstairs: rooftop seating is limited and not guaranteed.

items.q: Is a rooftop seat guaranteed on Floating Lotus?
items.a: No. Everyone has a seat on the heated lower deck; rooftop seats are first come, first served.

items.q: Can kids come on Floating Lotus?
items.a: Yes. Children 7 and under pay a fixed €25; from 8 it is the adult fare. Soft drinks and lemonade are included.

items.q: Which drinks are unlimited on Floating Lotus?
items.a: Prosecco, Aperol Spritz, Hugo Spritz, selected Hungarian wines, craft beer, Heineken, soft drinks, homemade lemonade and water. Premium spirits and cocktails are not included.

items.q: Is there commentary on Floating Lotus?
items.a: Yes, English audio commentary through a QR code on your own phone, so bring headphones.

items.q: When should I arrive for Floating Lotus?
items.a: 15 minutes early at Petőfi tér 9: boarding closes 5 minutes before each departure (18:00, 19:30 and 21:00).
